title: Hong Kong
summary: Hong Kong is a special administrative region on China's southern coast. Hong Kong Island was ceded to Britain in 1841–1842, with Kowloon added in 1860 and the New Territories leased in 1898. It returned to China on 1 July 1997 and became a major global financial centre.

as_recorded.value: The handover of Hong Kong to China was at midnight on 1 July 1997

where.modern_name: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China

importance.justification: Major global financial centre whose 1997 handover ended British rule and shaped modern China's status.

sources.title: Hong Kong | History, China, Location, Map, & Facts | Britannica
